items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: That was my uncle, my Uncle Floyd. Uncle Floyd Thomas.

ctx.x: the alleyway or right next door -- you know how it is in the country, you're not across the alleyway, you're right next door-- a man had a lot of influence, I mean, to me. He'd play all the blues records. That was my uncle, my Uncle Floyd. Uncle Floyd Thomas. I've got to mention him because a lot of things I heard that's the first time I heard them, you know.
Oh, this was where you would hear these blues records?
